verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show Replit Agent can auto-provision a database with separate Development/Production environments directly inside the builder ('Agent provisions it automatically', 'Add a database so everything persists'), matching the story well. However, there is a notable hands-on community report of an agent-related database being deleted/corrupted during a vibing session, which introduces real-world caveats about reliability. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that provisioning works smoothly at scale, more detail on database types/configuration options, and resolution of the community incident showing agent-database interaction can fail catastrophically.
